name: How do I determine if my wall is load-bearing before a modification?

mainEntity.name: How do I determine if my wall is load-bearing before a modification?

acceptedAnswer.text: Determining if a wall is load-bearing requires careful assessment, as it supports structural weight from above. Key indicators include its position relative to the foundation and roof, joist direction, and whether it has a wall directly above it on an upper floor. Exterior walls are almost always load-bearing. For interior walls, if floor joists run perpendicular to the wall and rest on it, it’s likely load-bearing. Always consult a structural engineer or experienced general contractor to confirm before any modifications.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look at its position, joist direction, and walls above it. Exterior walls are typically load-bearing. Always consult a professional to confirm.
